```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

<br>
**1. Housekeeping**
```{r housekeeping, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(growthrates)
library(multcompView)
library(ggthemes)

setwd("/PATH")

df <- read_excel("PANGAEA_GROWTHRATE_DATA")
df <- df[,c(2,3,5:7,15)]
```

<br>
**2. Calculation of specific growth rates**
```{r calculation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df$start <- 1500 #entering start density
df$spec_growth <- ((log(df$cells_per_ml)-log(df$start))/df$harvest_day) #calculate growth rates
df <- dplyr::group_by(df, temp, light, bac)
df <- dplyr::mutate(df, mean_r = mean(spec_growth), sd_r = sd(spec_growth)) #mean and sd
df$temp <- as.factor(df$temp)
df$light <- as.factor(df$light)
```

<br>
**3. Plotting growth rates**
```{r plotting, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p1 <- df %>% ggplot(aes(light, mean_r, fill = bac))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.5, position=position_dodge())+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_r-sd_r, ymax=mean_r+sd_r), width=.2,
                position=position_dodge(.5))+
  facet_grid(~temp)+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Paired")+
  theme_light()
p1
#ggsave("growth.eps", p1, device = "eps", units = "cm", width = 10, height = 10, dpi300)

p2 <- df %>% ggplot(aes(light, spec_growth, fill = bac))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  facet_grid(~temp)+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Paired")+
   labs(x="Photoperiod (h)", y="Specific growth rate µ (day^-1)")+
 # theme_light()+
    theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
p2

ggsave("growth_boxplot.eps", p2, device = "eps", units = "cm", width = 10, height = 10, dpi=300)

```
<br>
**4. statistics**
```{r statistics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

str(df)

#define factors
df$bac <- as.factor(df$bac)
df$temp <- as.factor(df$temp)
df$light <- as.factor(df$light)

#formulate the model
m1 <- aov(data = df, spec_growth~bac*temp*light,
            contrasts = list(temperature="contr.sum", daylength="contr.sum", bacteria="contr.sum")) 

#check assumptions
plot(m1)
hist(resid(m1))

#call for the output
summary(m1)
t1 <- TukeyHSD(m1)
print(t1)

library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)

# Subset data by bacterial condition
df_axenic <- df %>% filter(bac == "ax")
df_xenic <- df %>% filter(bac == "xe")

# Fit models separately for axenic and xenic
m_axenic <- aov(spec_growth ~ temp * light, data = df_axenic)
m_xenic <- aov(spec_growth ~ temp * light, data = df_xenic)

# Estimated marginal means for temp and light within each group
em_temp_axenic <- emmeans(m_axenic, ~ temp)
em_temp_xenic <- emmeans(m_xenic, ~ temp)
em_light_axenic <- emmeans(m_axenic, ~ light)
em_light_xenic <- emmeans(m_xenic, ~ light)

# Calculate effect sizes (Cohen's d) for temp contrasts
eff_temp_axenic <- eff_size(em_temp_axenic, sigma = sigma(m_axenic), edf = df.residual(m_axenic))
eff_temp_xenic <- eff_size(em_temp_xenic, sigma = sigma(m_xenic), edf = df.residual(m_xenic))

# Calculate effect sizes (Cohen's d) for light contrasts
eff_light_axenic <- eff_size(em_light_axenic, sigma = sigma(m_axenic), edf = df.residual(m_axenic))
eff_light_xenic <- eff_size(em_light_xenic, sigma = sigma(m_xenic), edf = df.residual(m_xenic))

# Convert to data frames for easier comparison
df_eff_sizes <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(eff_temp_axenic) %>% mutate(factor = "Temperature", condition = "Axenic"),
  as.data.frame(eff_temp_xenic) %>% mutate(factor = "Temperature", condition = "Xenic"),
  as.data.frame(eff_light_axenic) %>% mutate(factor = "Light", condition = "Axenic"),
  as.data.frame(eff_light_xenic) %>% mutate(factor = "Light", condition = "Xenic")
)

# Select and print relevant columns: factor, condition, effect size (effect.size)
t1<- df_eff_sizes %>%
  select(factor, condition, effect.size, lower.CL, upper.CL) %>%
  print()

library(writexl)
write_xlsx(t1, "effect_sizes.xlsx")

```
